conclusion: The dark vertical/scalloped upper-lid marks are caused by the source Skin Base Color contribution.
decisive_control: Only disconnecting Base Color and assigning a constant color removes the marks while keeping geometry, lights, normal map, roughness, SSS, lashes and wetline unchanged.
additional_controls: Disconnecting normal/coat normal does not restore the marks. Hiding lashes and then using plain clay also leaves the lids smooth. The small highlight ridge at the closed margin persists as geometry/light response; that is separate from the dark patterned marks.
scope: This supports a wider upper-lid diffuse cleanup than the parent narrow rim strip. It does not prove that every existing lid shading defect is a texture issue.
original_attribution: Initial diffuse attribution was made before causal isolation and was retracted pending these tests; it is now supported by the controlled constant-color result.
